# Symptom is not the fault

`customer_support.heu.root_cause_analysis.symptom_is_not_the_fault` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> The reported symptom is almost never the fault. It is the outermost point at which the fault became visible to someone with a keyboard.


## The heuristic

**The reported symptom is almost never the fault. It is the outermost point at which the fault became visible to someone with a keyboard.**


_Why:_ Customers can only report what their layer of the system exposes, and error surfaces are designed to be generic. The distance between the symptom and the fault is roughly the depth of the stack between them, which is why the fix that matches the symptom's wording is nearly always the wrong fix.
